gloss: to reach a dead end, to stall

definitions.gloss: to reach a dead end, to come to an impasse
definitions.explanation: To find oneself unable to proceed further in a physical path, plan, or negotiation. The situation cannot move forward.

definitions.gloss: to get stuck, to stall, to be at a loss
definitions.explanation: To become unable to continue work or thinking because of difficulties. Often used for creative blocks or problem-solving.

examples.japanese: {交渉|こうしょう}が{行|い}き{詰|づ}まった。
{計画|けいかく}が{行|い}き{詰|づ}まっている。
{事業|じぎょう}が{行|い}き{詰|づ}まって、{倒産|とうさん}の{危機|きき}に{瀕|ひん}している。
examples.english: The business has reached an impasse and is on the verge of bankruptcy.

examples.japanese: {考|かんが}えが{行|い}き{詰|づ}まった。
examples.english: My thinking has hit a wall.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}で{行|い}き{詰|づ}まったら、{休憩|きゅうけい}を{取|と}るといい。
examples.english: When you get stuck at work, it's good to take a break.

examples.japanese: {小説|しょうせつ}を{書|か}いていて{行|い}き{詰|づ}まったので、{気分転換|きぶんてんかん}に{散歩|さんぽ}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: I got stuck writing my novel, so I went for a walk to clear my head.

notes:
{行|い}き{詰|づ}まる means to reach a point where progress is no longer possible.

CONJUGATION (godan verb):
- Dictionary: {行|い}き{詰|づ}まる
- Negative: {行|い}き{詰|づ}まらない
- Past: {行|い}き{詰|づ}まった
- Te-form: {行|い}き{詰|づ}まって

COMMON SUBJECTS:
- {交渉|こうしょう}が{行|い}き{詰|づ}まる (negotiations stall)
- {計画|けいかく}が{行|い}き{詰|づ}まる (plan hits a dead end)
- {経営|けいえい}が{行|い}き{詰|づ}まる (management reaches an impasse)

RELATED: {行|い}き{詰|づ}まり (noun: deadlock, impasse)
